title: OpenDocuments solution assistant trial: knowledge-base PoC brief
taskScope: Use OpenDocuments as a public reference to draft a controlled solution-assistant PoC brief for a document Q&A or knowledge-base assistant scenario. The output is a trial artifact, not a production delivery claim.

fixedQuestions.title: Reference project understanding
fixedQuestions.prompt: Summarize the public reference capabilities of OpenDocuments that matter for a customer-facing knowledge-base assistant scenario.

fixedQuestions.title: Solution-role connection
fixedQuestions.prompt: Explain which solution-assistant tasks this reference can help you practice, such as scenario discovery, PoC scoping, demo scripting, and handoff documentation.

fixedQuestions.title: Customer scenario gap
fixedQuestions.prompt: List the customer information, source access rules, stakeholder review steps, and unresolved risks that would be needed before a real PoC.

fixedQuestions.title: PoC brief
fixedQuestions.prompt: Draft a PoC brief covering customer context, document scope, demo flow, success indicators, handoff checklist, and review boundaries.

fixedQuestions.title: Handoff and feedback plan
fixedQuestions.prompt: Write a lightweight handoff and feedback plan for implementation, support, user training, and issue triage without claiming production delivery.

fixedQuestions.title: Portfolio boundary
fixedQuestions.prompt: Write a portfolio-safe summary that separates public reference capabilities, your scenario analysis, and the limits of the PoC brief.

forbiddenClaims: Do not state or imply that the user delivered an enterprise implementation.
Do not state or imply customer delivery results, timeline reductions, cost savings, sales conversion, or production readiness.
Do not state or imply official OpenDocuments contribution.
Do not state or imply a complete system replication.

Do not state or imply capability certification, employment outcome prediction, company screening, resume packaging, real repository RAG, live repository search, multi-project intelligent recommendation, or score-based ranking.
Do not state or imply that AI replaces contract, specification, construction, security, compliance, or domain review.
disclaimer: This template is for Pathfinder P1-B.1 trial preparation. OpenDocuments is used only as a public reference project. Outputs are scenario analysis and PoC-planning artifacts, not customer delivery proof, employment judgments, official project contribution, live repository analysis, or professional review.
